facts.fact: The Zanzibar ministry reports issuing 29,475 digital introduction letters through the addressing system between July 2025 and March 2026.

facts.fact: The Zanzibar ministry reports drafting the Personal Data Protection Act, 2026 and plans to finalise it in 2026/27.
The Zanzibar ministry reports approving construction of 27 communication towers and plans towers in underserved areas of Unguja and Pemba with the Universal Communications Service Access Fund.

facts.fact: The Zanzibar ministry says it trained 1,015 citizens in digital skills (639 women, 376 men) between July 2025 and March 2026 and will continue ICT training through community centres.

facts.fact: The Zanzibar Minister for Communication, Information Technology and Innovation presented a 53.39bn/- ministry budget for 2026/27 to the House of Representatives.
